features.text: SOFT PROTECTIVE LAYER: Worn beneath any functional knee brace to reduce friction and skin irritation.
MULTIPLE MATERIAL OPTIONS: Choose Cotton/Lycra for breathability, Neoprene for cushioning, or Supplex/Lycra for stretch.
OPEN OR CLOSED PATELLA: Available with either style for personalized kneecap coverage and comfort.
ENHANCED BRACE STABILITY: Improves brace suspension and maintains position during movement.
SENSITIVE-SKIN FRIENDLY: Prevents chafing and pressure points for users wearing braces long-term.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
